source_tests: partial-NA influence functions propagate identically across modes (unbalanced panel)
reason: The R source injects NA values through a custom est_method callback and compares internal influence-function propagation across R fast/slow paths. The Stata port has no public custom-estimator callback API or public path that accepts user-supplied influence functions.
accepted_behavior: Public Stata fast/nofast behavior is verified through no-covariate equality, requested-fast covariate optimized equality, aggregation equality, F032, PY009, and RT025.
